datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule throughout 2013 across Kenya. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity) were compiled into spatial datasets for January, April, July, and October 2013, with multiple scenarios documented to represent different food security outcomes.
